name: week
title: The ethics office this week
subtitle: What is waiting, what is late and what is coming up. Rendered by npm run view.

sections.title: The queue
sections.note: Every application not yet decided, with the decision clock (days with the researcher do not count).
sections.sql: select d.name as application, d.title, d.committee, d.pathway, d.status, d.clock_days as days_on_clock, d.reviews_out, d.meeting from application_detail d where d.status in ('submitted', 'in review', 'revisions') order by d.submitted_on

sections.title: Reviews late
sections.sql: select a.name as application, m.name as reviewer, r.due_on, ethics_today() - r.due_on as days_late from reviews r join applications a on a.id = r.application_id join members m on m.id = r.member_id where r.returned_on is null and r.conflict is null and r.due_on < ethics_today() and a.status in ('submitted', 'in review') order by r.due_on

sections.title: Next meetings
sections.sql: select m.name as meeting, m.meets_on, m.closes_on as agenda_closes, count(a.id)::int as items from meetings m left join applications a on a.meeting_id = m.id where m.meets_on >= ethics_today() and not m.held group by m.id order by m.meets_on

sections.title: Decision letters not sent
sections.sql: select name as application, decision, decided_on from applications where decided_on is not null and letter_sent_on is null order by decided_on

name: monitoring
title: Monitoring approved research
subtitle: Reports, expiring approvals, safety and animal numbers.

sections.title: Progress reports due in 30 days or late
sections.sql: select name as application, investigator, next_report_due, last_report_on from approvals where days_to_expiry >= 0 and days_to_report <= 30 order by next_report_due

sections.title: Approvals ending in 90 days or ended
sections.sql: select name as application, investigator, expires_on, days_to_expiry from approvals where days_to_expiry <= 90 order by expires_on

sections.title: Open safety and conduct reports
sections.sql: select e.name, a.name as application, e.kind, e.occurred_on, e.reported_on, e.summary from events e join applications a on a.id = e.application_id where e.closed_on is null order by e.occurred_on

sections.title: Animal numbers
sections.sql: select name as application, species, animals_approved as approved, animals_used as used, animals_approved - animals_used as remaining from approvals where animals_approved is not null order by animals_approved - animals_used

name: committees
title: Committees
subtitle: Membership by category, terms and turnaround.

sections.title: Membership by category
sections.sql: select committee, category, members, external, names from membership order by committee, category

sections.title: Terms ending in 90 days or ended
sections.sql: select c.name as committee, m.name, m.category, m.term_ends_on from members m join committees c on c.id = m.committee_id where m.active and m.term_ends_on <= ethics_today() + 90 order by m.term_ends_on

sections.title: Turnaround in the last 12 months
sections.note: Days from a valid submission to a decision, with the clock stopped while the researcher responds.
sections.sql: select committee, pathway, count(*)::int as decided, round(avg(clock_days)) as average_days, max(clock_days) as slowest_days from application_detail where decided_on >= ethics_today() - 365 and clock_days is not null group by committee, pathway order by committee, pathway
